10k.summary: agenT-797 (allogeneic native iNKT cell therapy) is in Phase 2 clinical development across multiple indications constituting a pipeline within a single product candidate: 2L gastroesophageal cancer (Phase 2 investigator-sponsored at MSK), severe pneumonia/AHRF (Phase 2 randomized adaptive placebo-controlled), and HSCT/GvHD. Engineered programs MiNK-413 (BCMA-CAR-iNKT) and MiNK-215 (FAP-CAR-iNKT) are preclinical.

website.summary: Pipeline page is dated (still showing Phase 1 readouts from 2021/2022); 10-K is the canonical and most recent source. Used 10-K for highest phase.

ctgov.note: All three MiNK-sponsored trials are completed (oncology solid tumor NCT05108623, COVID-ARDS NCT04582201, R/R MM NCT04754100). Currently active Phase 2 studies (gastroesophageal investigator-sponsored at MSK; severe pneumonia/AHRF; GvHD) are not yet visible in this sponsor's ctgov pull.

pipeline.modality: Allogeneic native invariant Natural Killer T (iNKT) cell therapy
pipeline.target: CD1d / NK and innate ligands (multimodal tumor and immune microenvironment engagement); when combined: PD-1 / CTLA-4 axes
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (with Agenus License Agreement providing access to immuno-oncology antibodies for combinations)

indications.indication: Second-line gastroesophageal / gastric / GEJ adenocarcinoma (combination with botensilimab + balstilimab + ramucirumab + paclitaxel)
indications.trial_name: Phase 2 investigator-sponsored study (Memorial Sloan Kettering, Dr. Yelena Janjigian)
indications.trial_design: Investigator-sponsored Phase 2 evaluating agenT-797 in combination with botensilimab + balstilimab + ramucirumab + paclitaxel in previously treated advanced esophageal/gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma
key_milestones: Confirmed responses previously reported in chemo and anti-PD-1 refractory gastric cancer

indications.indication: Severe pneumonia with moderate-to-severe acute hypoxemic respiratory failure (AHRF)
indications.trial_design: Randomized, adaptive, placebo-controlled Phase 2 in severe pneumonia / moderate-to-severe AHRF; follows completed Phase 1/2 in COVID-19 ARDS (NCT04582201)
key_milestones: Prior Phase 1/2 ARDS readout: 30-day survival >70% in 21 mechanically ventilated patients

indications.indication: Graft-versus-host disease (GvHD) / peri-transplant in HSCT recipients
indications.trial_design: Development of agenT-797 in peri-transplant setting to improve engraftment and reduce GvHD

excluded_preclinical: Bispecific iNKT cell engagers — preclinical platform
excluded_legacy_terminated: agenT-797 Phase 1 in r/r solid tumors (NCT05108623) — completed
agenT-797 Phase 1 in COVID-19 ARDS (NCT04582201) — completed (informed advancement to severe pneumonia/AHRF Phase 2)
agenT-797 Phase 1 in r/r multiple myeloma (NCT04754100) — completed
